customer_drafts.subject: Your navy hoodie order
customer_drafts.body:
Thanks for reaching out. We understand you’re looking for 20 navy hoodies in size M and asking about bulk pricing. I’m sorry, but we currently have 8 size M available, so we can’t fulfill all 20 in that size from current stock. We’re confirming whether additional size-M stock can be arranged and whether bulk pricing can be approved; neither timing nor a discounted price is confirmed yet. If your group is open to a mix, current stock includes 4 S, 8 M, 14 L, and 6 XL. Would a mixed-size order work for your group, or do you need all 20 in M?
